facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes; service exporters don't have to surrender their foreign earnings.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks open foreign-currency accounts freely; USD accounts are common.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Mobile money is widespread; no gateway for individual online sellers found.
facts.L1_registration: Register through the GUCE one-stop shop; real cost and time vary widely.
facts.L2_tax_id: Tax number assigned at the GUCE during business registration.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Since 2026 worldwide income is taxed; micro-enterprises under CDF 25m pay USD 30 flat.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 16% VAT above CDF 80m turnover; treatment of exported services not confirmed.
facts.L5_data_protection: Digital Code: declare data processing before starting; the regulator isn't set up yet.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can withdraw within just 72 hours.
facts.L7_incentives: No freelancer incentive; micro-enterprises pay a flat USD 30.
facts.D1_id_document: Voter card (no national ID card since 1997).

watch_out.text: Old guides say foreign income is untaxed; that changed in January 2026.
The refund window is only 72 hours, not 14 days.
